args.description: March 2026 bank service charges unrecorded in the ledger in all three entities, causing the only ledger-to-bank difference in Cash - Operating (GL 1000) at 3/31/26. Account 6900 (Bank Fees) shows zero March activity in US, UK and DE. Unrecorded: US $65.00 (BT-US-0084, DOC-0202), UK GBP 22.00 (BT-UK-0055, DOC-0204), DE EUR 38.50 (BT-DE-0051, DOC-0203). Aggregate overstatement of consolidated cash = USD 134.85 at Treasury 3/31 rates (GBP 1.2500, EUR 1.1000, DOC-0200). Payroll accounts (GL 1010) tie to bank exactly; savings (GL 1020) are nil. Not posting corrective entries as this request was read-only reporting; flagging for the open Bank reconciliation checklist items. Per-entity ledger cash otherwise ties to the March bank statements.

args.text:
MEMO - Consolidated Cash Position at March 31, 2026 (USD)
Prepared by: david.murguia@gmail.com | Date: 2026-04-03 | Period: March 2026 (close in progress)

PURPOSE
Report consolidated cash at 3/31/2026 in USD using Treasury month-end policy rates, broken out by entity in local currency and USD. Figures are taken from the general ledger only, as requested.

FX RATES USED (DOC-0200, "Month-end FX rates Q1 2026 (Treasury policy rates)", dated 2026-03-31; USD per 1 unit of currency)
  2026-03 GBP = 1.2500
  2026-03 EUR = 1.1000
  USD = 1.0000 (functional)

CASH ACCOUNTS INCLUDED
GL 1000 Cash - Operating, GL 1010 Cash - Payroll, GL 1020 Cash - Savings. GL 1020 has a nil ending balance in all three entities, so consolidated cash = GL 1000 + GL 1010.

BY ENTITY (ledger ending balances, 2026-03, debit-minus-credit)
US - Halvard Systems Inc. (USD)
  GL 1000 Cash - Operating      1,636,957.20
  GL 1010 Cash - Payroll           40,000.00
  GL 1020 Cash - Savings                0.00
  Local total            USD   1,676,957.20
  Rate 1.0000            USD   1,676,957.20

UK - Halvard Systems Ltd (GBP)
  GL 1000 Cash - Operating        552,789.56
  GL 1010 Cash - Payroll           15,000.00
  GL 1020 Cash - Savings                0.00
  Local total            GBP     567,789.56
  x 1.2500               USD     709,736.95

DE - Halvard Systems GmbH (EUR)
  GL 1000 Cash - Operating        352,136.36
  GL 1010 Cash - Payroll           12,000.00
  GL 1020 Cash - Savings                0.00
  Local total            EUR     364,136.36
  x 1.1000               USD     400,550.00

CONSOLIDATED CASH AT 3/31/2026 = USD 2,787,244.15
  (US 1,676,957.20 + UK 709,736.95 + DE 400,550.00)
Mix: US 60.2%, UK 25.5%, DE 14.4%.

SOURCES
- Ledger balances: get_account_balance for accounts 1000/1010/1020, entities US/UK/DE, period 2026-03.
- FX: DOC-0200 (Treasury policy rates, 2026-03-31). DOC-0200 directs these rates be used for remeasurement, translation and intercompany charges.
- Corroborating bank statements: DOC-0202 (US Operating), DOC-0205 (US Payroll), DOC-0204 (UK Operating), DOC-0199 (UK Payroll), DOC-0203 (DE Operating), DOC-0201 (DE Payroll).

QUALIFICATION - LEDGER DOES NOT YET TIE TO BANK (EXC-001)
The above is the ledger position as requested, but it is not yet final. Ledger GL 1000 exceeds the March bank statement closing balance in every entity, by exactly the unrecorded March monthly service charge:
  US   ledger 1,636,957.20 vs bank 1,636,892.20  diff  USD 65.00   (BT-US-0084, DOC-0202)
  UK   ledger   552,789.56 vs bank   552,767.56  diff  GBP 22.00   (BT-UK-0055, DOC-0204)
  DE   ledger   352,136.36 vs bank   352,097.86  diff  EUR 38.50   (BT-DE-0051, DOC-0203)
Confirmed root cause: GL 6900 Bank Fees shows zero March activity in all three entities (US ending 130.00, UK 44.00, DE 77.00 are Jan-Feb only). Payroll accounts (GL 1010) tie to bank exactly in all three entities.

Effect: consolidated cash above is overstated by USD 134.85 (65.00 + 22.00x1.25 + 38.50x1.10). On a bank-reconciled basis consolidated cash would be USD 2,787,109.30 (US 1,676,892.20; UK GBP 567,767.56 = 709,709.45; DE EUR 364,097.86 = 400,507.65).

I did not post the correcting entries, as this request was read-only reporting and posting would have changed the figure being reported. The three fees are fully supported by the bank statements and can be booked (Dr 6900 / Cr 1000 in each entity) as part of the open "Bank reconciliations" checklist items, which remain open for US, UK and DE. I have logged EXC-001 for controller review. No checklist items were marked complete.

OTHER NOTES
- The remaining 73 March bank lines are all still unmatched in the reconciliation tool; that is a matching/documentation status only and does not by itself indicate a further ledger misstatement, since the net ledger-to-bank difference is fully explained by the three service charges above.
- Amounts are pre-close; other open March items (depreciation, prepaid amortization, payroll accrual, AP cutoff, revenue recognition, intercompany) are non-cash or accrual in nature and are not expected to change the 3/31 cash balances.
- Translation above uses the 3/31 spot/policy rate for all balances, appropriate for a cash position report. CTA impact on equity is not addressed here.

RECOMMENDATION
Approve booking the three bank fee entries, then re-issue the consolidated cash figure at USD 2,787,109.30. If a number is needed immediately for treasury/forecasting purposes, use the bank-reconciled USD 2,787,109.30 rather than the raw ledger USD 2,787,244.15.
